name: stockgraber-web
description: StockGraber — a dark-themed web stock charter (candlesticks, MA crossovers, RSI/MACD, percent-change index comparison) backed by Yahoo Finance.

scripts.install:all: bun install && cd web && bun install && cd ../server && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:web"
